## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 7 dishes, none Benin-only.
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 3 dishes shared with Nigeria/Togo (yam porridge, mashed beans, pounded yam).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Benin; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 101 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 18 biomarker concentration values measured in a Beninese population (no cancer or intake correlations).
- No Duke records. [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Benin on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Benin-only dishes (Fon cuisine absent).
- WAFCT not yet processed.
